description: This file implements a class named AlbumArtCache that provides caching and asynchronous loading of album art images for a media browser service in an Android application.

classes.name: AlbumArtCache
classes.description: A singleton class providing cache management and asynchronous fetching for album art bitmaps.

classes.name: AlbumArtCache.FetchListener
classes.description: An abstract callback class for notifying when album art has been successfully fetched or when an error occurs.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of AlbumArtCache.

methods.name: getBigImage
methods.description: Retrieves the cached large version of the album art for the given URL.

methods.name: getIconImage
methods.description: Retrieves the cached icon-sized version of the album art for the given URL.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous fetch of album art for the provided URL, invoking the callback upon completion or error.
